auth_rejected.title: Larnitech ({title}): the API key was rejected
auth_rejected.description: The controller is reachable but refuses this API key. Check that the key still matches the one in LT_Setup, and that the API is switched on for this controller — a disabled API is rejected the same way a wrong key is. Home Assistant keeps retrying in the background, so this clears itself as soon as the controller accepts the key again.

mass_device_removal.title: Larnitech ({title}): more than half of the known devices disappeared

confirm.title: Remove the missing Larnitech devices?
confirm.description: {missing} of {total} previously-known devices are absent from the last `get-devices` snapshot on "{title}" — far more than a single device dropping off. This is more often a controller/network hiccup, a misconfigured object, or the wrong server than a real mass removal. Confirm only if you're sure these devices are actually gone from Larnitech; otherwise leave this unconfirmed and check the connection first — the issue clears on its own once a normal snapshot comes back.

read_only_write_blocked.message: "{title}" is in read-only mode, so Home Assistant did not send this change to Larnitech. Turn read-only off in the integration options to control this controller.

modbus_bad_port.message: "{port}" is not a com-port of this Larnitech controller.

modbus_bad_values.message: Writing needs values: exactly one for function 6, one or more for function 16.

modbus_timeout.message: No answer from the device on port {port}. Check the slave ID, the register and the wiring — the bus is shared with the controller's own script.

modbus_exception.message: The device rejected the request with Modbus exception code {code}.

modbus_request.name: Modbus request
modbus_request.description: Reads or writes Modbus registers on a device behind a Larnitech com-port (RS-485 or Modbus TCP). A read returns the registers; a write succeeds once the device confirms it. Reads also work in read-only mode, writes do not. The bus is shared with the controller's own script: send only what that script could send itself.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The Larnitech controller the port belongs to.

port.name: Port
port.description: Address of the com-port widget, e.g. 210:1.

slave.name: Slave ID
slave.description: Modbus address of the device on the bus (1-247).

function.name: Function
function.description: 3 = read holding registers, 4 = read input registers, 6 = write one register, 16 = write several registers.

address.name: Register
address.description: Address of the first register (0-65535), numbered from zero as in the device documentation.

count.name: Count
count.description: How many registers to read (functions 3 and 4).

values.name: Values
values.description: What to write: one value for function 6, a list for function 16.
